verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at openrouter.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a structured product summary). The docs also expose an llms-full.txt and per-page .md versions of guides, and the official MCP server lets an assistant pull docs directly. The /docs.md root returning 404 is a small inconsistency but does not undercut the core capability. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents using the llms.txt/markdown docs in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Install the migration skill to let your agent handle the import updates for you
your assistant can pull live OpenRouter data (models, prices, your credits, rankings, and docs)
